## ICdcRecord interface

Durable outbox record — the subscriber event plus routing metadata.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface ICdcRecord extends ICdcEvent 
```
**Extends:** [ICdcEvent](./lmdb.icdcevent.md)

## Remarks

Appended in the same writer transaction as the primary write, so aborts publish nothing and sequences stay gapless per env.
